surfaces.condition: Repository evidence, persistence, routing, provider, quality, remediation, or command contracts change.
A projected field, state label, navigation surface, or user-visible remediation behavior changes.
The native CLI binary, command syntax, JSON schema, or prerequisite resolution changes.
Agent-visible commands, documentation and skill relationships, freshness semantics, authorization boundaries, or routing behavior changes.
validation: Validate every documented command against pnpm cli help.
Verify relative context links resolve inside the repository.
Run a scoped Quality Runner fleet audit and inspect agent_usability.

surfaces.condition: Product boundaries, architecture, remediation order, quality gates, release behavior, or operator workflow changes.
validation: Review docs against .agents/context/commands.md and package.json scripts.

surfaces.owner: Pronto repository maintainers and provider-neutral skill routing
surfaces.condition: Repository mutation isolation, task receipt, pre-commit enforcement, or integration-readiness behavior changes.
validation: Run the skill creator quick validator against skills/isolated-change-workflow.
Verify a resolved worktree root nested under the source checkout fails before directory, branch, or receipt creation, while an external sibling root remains accepted.
Build fresh-agent fixtures from a baseline that commits every required hook and test configuration file, including force-added ignored files such as .pre-cr.json when applicable.
Forward-test positive, negative, and same-line-conflict cases before projecting the skill externally.

surfaces.condition: The desired remediation state, product truth, progress, blocker, drift, or continuity evidence changes.
Fallback, degradation, evidence normalization, or negative-path behavior changes.
validation: Run Quality Runner verify-gates with --only-gate failure_visibility in disposable mode and inspect evidence_state.

surfaces.owner: Codex runtime fork and Pronto provider adapter

Start a fresh Codex process and verify an observed metric through pnpm cli skills --json.

surfaces.condition: Quality Runner changes its maturity feed, repository identity, gate, finding, agent-usability, growth-health, freshness, or provenance contract.
